startingPoint: Limited resources, no investments, little spare money; I can spend 15 minutes today reviewing my accounts. No current net worth number is known.

waypoints.title: Account baseline established
waypoints.rationale: Clear visibility into current balances and fixed commitments forms the foundation.
waypoints.completionCriteria: All accounts reviewed and current totals documented.

waypoints.title: Positive monthly margin created
waypoints.rationale: Consistent positive cash flow is required to accumulate assets over time.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Expenses reduced or income adjusted to consistently retain $100 monthly.

waypoints.title: Initial emergency buffer formed
waypoints.rationale: An accessible reserve prevents minor emergencies from derailing financial stability.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Five hundred dollars held separately for unexpected costs.

waypoints.title: First investment vehicle opened
waypoints.rationale: Capital must be placed in instruments capable of compound growth.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Account opened and configured for automatic transfers.

waypoints.title: Portfolio reaches five thousand dollars
waypoints.rationale: Crossing initial asset thresholds builds momentum toward larger targets.

suggestedOneMove.title: Review account balances for 15 minutes
suggestedOneMove.rationale: Looking directly at current accounts initiates the baseline review without financial risk.

proposal.guidance: Reviewing accounts establishes the baseline needed to understand your starting point.

waypoints.title: Account snapshot written down
waypoints.rationale: Writing down all balances and debts provides a clear baseline without needing setup steps.

requirements.title: List every checking and savings account balance

waypoints.completionCriteria: A complete list of current account balances and total debts is recorded on paper or screen.

waypoints.title: Small monthly surplus identified
waypoints.rationale: Finding even a modest gap between income and expenses creates room to save.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Monthly expenses are tracked and a consistent surplus of at least twenty five dollars is mapped out.

waypoints.title: Initial cash buffer gathered
waypoints.rationale: A small reserve protects against immediate shocks before moving to investments.
waypoints.completionCriteria: One hundred dollars is set aside in a separate place designated for unexpected expenses.

waypoints.title: Basic savings account opened
waypoints.rationale: Establishing a dedicated account separates everyday spending from growth funds.
waypoints.completionCriteria: A separate savings vehicle is active and ready for transfers.

waypoints.title: Portfolio reaches one thousand dollars
waypoints.rationale: Reaching four figures establishes the first major compounding milestone.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Total combined balances in savings and growth accounts total one thousand dollars.

suggestedOneMove.title: Spend fifteen minutes writing down all current account balances and debt totals
suggestedOneMove.rationale: This uses your allocated time today to map out reality without needing any initial financial resources.

proposal.guidance: Starting with a simple written snapshot removes the pressure of large financial targets and works within your available time.
